Docs.summary:
Provides platform-specific implementations for alert, action sheet, and prompt dialogs. Custom platform backends can implement this interface and register it via dependency injection to provide custom dialog implementations.
Note: This interface is used by the default AlertManager implementation. If a custom is registered via dependency injection, this interface will not be resolved by the framework — the custom is responsible for its own subscription management.
